task: Science Legends measured lag, UX, animation, enemy variety and skill texture improvements

baseline.conditions: Local real production page with generated art, headless Edge, desktop 1280×900/DPR1 and mobile 390×844/DPR2; mobile CPU throttled 4×. Instrumented work counts are controlled comparisons, not a claim about every device or universal FPS.

rounds.feedback: Stable health and experience are rewritten every120 Hz step; mobile baseline logged4713DOM mutations in2seconds.
acceptance: Stable health/XP/status produces no repeated DOM mutations.
Damage/healing remain immediate and accessible.

implementation.change: Added cached HUD nodes and value-diffed health, experience, status and ARIA updates.

verification.result: 23 independent observed-work assertions passed across rounds 1–10. Existing health, target, gesture, projection, facing, late-source and all-skill visual browser regressions also passed; 36 model/combat/view/action unit tests passed.

rounds.feedback: Every substep queries cooldown elements, traversesclosest parents, and rewrites ready names/ARIA.
acceptance: No cooldown DOM rediscovery during simulation substeps.
Ready skills produce no redundant mutations; real cooldown values remain accurate.

implementation.change: Cached cooldown node records when the hotbar is rendered and stopped rediscovering or rewriting unchanged labels.

verification.result: 23 independent observed-work assertions passed across rounds 1–10. Existing health, target, gesture, projection, facing, late-source and all-skill visual browser regressions also passed; 36 model/combat/view/action unit tests passed.

rounds.feedback: Question/wave/evade labels and battleStatus innerHTML are rewritten even when the displayed value is unchanged.
acceptance: No mutations when displayed timersecond/wave/ready state is unchanged.
Transitions update at their actual displayed boundary.

implementation.change: Only writes question seconds, wave status and evade display when the actual displayed value changes.

verification.result: 23 independent observed-work assertions passed across rounds 1–10. Existing health, target, gesture, projection, facing, late-source and all-skill visual browser regressions also passed; 36 model/combat/view/action unit tests passed.

rounds.feedback: Target visibility/name/type/HP/effects are rewritten repeatedly even when the target has not changed.
acceptance: Unchanged target panel causes zero mutation in thirty refreshes.
Damage, statuses and target switches refresh immediately.

implementation.change: Value-diffed target visibility, name, type, health and effects while preserving immediate target transitions.

verification.result: 23 independent observed-work assertions passed across rounds 1–10. Existing health, target, gesture, projection, facing, late-source and all-skill visual browser regressions also passed; 36 model/combat/view/action unit tests passed.

rounds.feedback: Every hover pick maps and sorts the full enemy array to identify the frontmost body.
acceptance: Pick preserves frontmost depth and original tie order.
No map/sort allocation occurs within a pick.

implementation.change: Replaced map/sort picking with a linear frontmost-depth selection that preserves original tie order.

verification.result: 23 independent observed-work assertions passed across rounds 1–10. Existing health, target, gesture, projection, facing, late-source and all-skill visual browser regressions also passed; 36 model/combat/view/action unit tests passed.

rounds.feedback: Mouseover picking occurs in each120Hz simulation substep rather than once per paint.
acceptance: Eighty substeps produce at most one hover pick.
Pointer-down selects a newly pointed actor immediately.

implementation.change: Moved hover picking to the render loop while retaining immediate pointer-down picking.

verification.result: 23 independent observed-work assertions passed across rounds 1–10. Existing health, target, gesture, projection, facing, late-source and all-skill visual browser regressions also passed; 36 model/combat/view/action unit tests passed.

rounds.feedback: Paused dense and tree scenes repaint roughly145times/1.2s, costing335–347ms mobile CPU despite frozen simulation.
acceptance: Frozen pause/tree scenes paint at most once after settling.
Explicit draw(), resize, resume and input redraw remain correct.

implementation.change: Added scene invalidation so frozen pause, menu, hidden and opaque-overlay scenes stop repeated world paints.

verification.result: 23 independent observed-work assertions passed across rounds 1–10. Existing health, target, gesture, projection, facing, late-source and all-skill visual browser regressions also passed; 36 model/combat/view/action unit tests passed.

rounds.feedback: Visible landmark lights create approximatelyseven gradients per paint on mobile andsixteen ondesktop.
acceptance: Twenty landmark paints create at most two gradients total.
Tiles remain anchored in world coordinates; flames may animate independently.

implementation.change: Cached a DPR-scoped static courtyard decoration tile; animated flames remain separate and world anchored.

verification.result: 23 independent observed-work assertions passed across rounds 1–10. Existing health, target, gesture, projection, facing, late-source and all-skill visual browser regressions also passed; 36 model/combat/view/action unit tests passed.

rounds.feedback: The full-viewport vignette gradient is recreated everypaint.
acceptance: Twenty atmosphere paints create at most one gradient.
Viewport size andDPR changes invalidate the cache.

implementation.change: Cached the atmosphere gradient by viewport dimensions and DPR.

verification.result: 23 independent observed-work assertions passed across rounds 1–10. Existing health, target, gesture, projection, facing, late-source and all-skill visual browser regressions also passed; 36 model/combat/view/action unit tests passed.

rounds.feedback: Actor queues/entries are rebuilt everypaint andpets are drawn even far beyond the viewport.
acceptance: Offscreen pets are culled before model rendering.
Stable actors reuse queue work without changing foot-depth order or labels.

implementation.change: Reused actor queue entries and render-order storage and culled offscreen companions.

verification.result: 23 independent observed-work assertions passed across rounds 1–10. Existing health, target, gesture, projection, facing, late-source and all-skill visual browser regressions also passed; 36 model/combat/view/action unit tests passed.

rounds.feedback: Normal-motion forced-crit Whirlwind advances 2.375 simulation seconds / 3.007 wall seconds (79% speed); reduced-motion runs at100%.
acceptance: Sustained critical channel maintains at least95% simulation/wall progress.
Heavy hits remain visibly impactful; fixedstep damage/collisions stay correct.

implementation.change: Continuous channel ticks keep visible impacts without repeated hit-stop; dramatic stops have a global cooldown. The fixed-step clock now consumes remaining wall time when a stop is requested midframe instead of discarding that time and charging it again.

verification.result: Six real-game browser checks and16combat unit tests passed. All30nearby foes still receive sustained critical damage.

rounds.feedback: Preparing all actor atlases synchronously caused startup long tasks up to 358 ms in the throttled-mobile baseline.
acceptance: Prepare complete actor frames off the main thread with bounded queued work.
A tested synchronous failure fallback and run-pinned sources remain correct.

implementation.change: Transferred bitmap decoding/readback and whole-silhouette extraction into one reusable worker with RGBA and synchronous fallbacks, idle retirement and per-run source pinning.

verification.result: 39 independent browser checks: zero normal-path main-thread extraction/readbacks; exact120-frame pixel/anchor parity across normal, unsupported, blocked, postMessage throw, bitmap reject/throw and RGBA fallback paths; idle retirement and late-ready run pinning pass.

rounds.feedback: After the first ten fixes, actor drawing still consumes 429 of 639 ms of dense draw CPU; the broad 180px center margin draws many fully offscreen bodies.
acceptance: Fully offscreen model/contact bounds issue no model draw.
Edge-crossing limbs, feet and shadows remain visible and correctly depth sorted.

implementation.change: Culled enemy and companion bodies from actual extracted model/contact bounds while retaining edge-crossing feet and limbs.

verification.result: 156 combined actor/FX checks at1280/DPR1 and390/DPR2 trace native painted image quads for six legacy enemies, front/rear and idle/walk/attack. Fully outside actors make0modelcalls; crossing silhouettes remain.

rounds.feedback: Eighty fully offscreen projectiles raised dense draw work to 718 ms in a 1.6-second synthetic stress window.
acceptance: Skip fully offscreen projectiles, trails, effects, texts and impacts.
Any warning or large blast intersecting the viewport still draws.

implementation.change: Skipped offscreen projectile, complete-trail, effect, impact, text, orb, hammer and zone paint work while conservatively retaining crossing chains and large warnings.

verification.result: 80 fully offscreen projectiles make0channel/image/stroke calls. Crossing trails/chains and large warnings centered outside the viewport remain painted; drawing changes no HP/kills/question/time state.

rounds.feedback: Homing and swept collisions scan every enemy for every projectile; 80 projectiles against 140 foes consumed 112–146 ms per 1.6-second controlled window.
acceptance: Use a shared bounded spatial broadphase for swept, homing and area queries.
Results agree with brute force for fast sweeps, moving/large targets, dead entries and tie order.

implementation.change: Added lazy dirty spatial broadphase for actual swept, homing, radius and arc queries, preserving original hit order and invalidating before movement-triggered retaliation.

verification.result: 7 real integration checks:250radius and250arc queries match brute-force order,20fast sweeps hit the same first targets, homing ties preserved; mean candidates2.05/max5 versus140enemies. Independent Guardian retaliation repro caught stale index during movement and now damages the moved mite to940HP.

rounds.feedback: After the first ten fixes, the dense scene still emits 1063 attribute mutations per two seconds, chiefly continuously changing cooldown shade transforms.
acceptance: Reduce active shade DOM update frequency while retaining smooth visible progress.
Readiness, direct refreshes, labels and accessible values remain immediate and truthful.

implementation.change: Paused compositor cooldown animations seek actual simulation progress once per paint; reduced-motion/unsupported fallback quantizes inline shading to10Hz and old loadout animations cancel.

verification.result: Independent native animation/style checks at1280/390/320: four active cooldowns produce0inline shade mutations across120steps; progress matches actual cooldown, pause stays exact, loadout replacement cancels old animations, fallback is bounded and ready states update immediately. R20 caption acceptance remains separate.

rounds.feedback: A real Frost Nova hitting 100 surviving foes constructed 101 WebAudio oscillators in a single cast, taking 13.6 ms on the desktop baseline.
acceptance: Bound simultaneous hit voices and repeated hit cues, and disconnect ended audio nodes.
Skill, defeat, level and question feedback cues remain available.

implementation.change: Gated overlapping combat cues, bounded total/combat audio voices, retained important feedback, disconnected ended nodes and removed gameplay random consumption from pitch.

verification.result: 9 native audio checks: actual100-target Frost Nova schedules2voices rather than101 and damages all100; total peak12, correct/wrong/death/level survive saturation, muted creates0nodes, pitch consumes0gameplay random, all41oscillator and41gain nodes actually disconnect.

rounds.feedback: Rapid multi-hit channels continually replace floating numbers, producing overlapping tick piles instead of a readable per-enemy result.
acceptance: Coalesce rapid per-enemy callouts into readable totals.
Actual health loss and critical emphasis remain truthful; rendering applies no damage.

implementation.change: Coalesced rapid same-target damage callouts over220ms without changing damage; retained critical emphasis and capped active text with safe eviction/expiry references.

verification.result: Actual21hits sum27HPdamage into1accurate critical-emphasized callout; later batch starts separately,60text cap and expired/evicted/restarted references do not corrupt newer callouts at1280/390/320.

rounds.feedback: Ordinary tiny or almost-full health bars and status labels cover dense groups and add work while selected threats need stronger priority.
acceptance: Retain selected, boss and elite health/status cues.
Ordinary near-player damage/status feedback stays readable with bounded clutter.

implementation.change: Prioritized important threat labels and bounded ordinary crowd health/status bars to12mobile/24desktop with local overlap suppression.

verification.result: Native fillRect tracing verifies ordinary bar budget and actual painted selected/hovered/elite/boss/committed-attack bars at1280/390/320; no reliance on internal selection counters.

rounds.feedback: The 390px baseline shows the SPIT caption underneath the bottom hotbar and overlapping resource controls.
acceptance: Keep imminent threat captions in the visible combat area above controls.
Warning geometry still points at the actual source/impact and is not hidden by skill effects.

implementation.change: Replaced mobile warning-label three-pass bouncing with a nearest obstacle-free horizontal/vertical interval solver, preserving the true world anchor and leader.

verification.result: 45 combined feedback checks across1280x900,390x844 and320x568. All38 actual canvas-painted captions stay in the viewport and avoid real visible HUD controls; the initial320px overlap was reproduced and fixed. Source anchors remain exact.

rounds.feedback: The legacy roster has no directional defender or timed guard-break opening.
acceptance: A real frontal guard reduces damage; flanks, heavy breaks and recovery expose it.

rounds.feedback: Ranged variety needs an avoidable locked ground attack with a meaningful interrupt.
acceptance: Lock the target location during windup; moving avoids it and stun/freeze retires it.

rounds.feedback: Enemy deaths need a distinct crowd-control decision without recursive or reward-farming offspring.
acceptance: Spawn at most two rewardless nonrecursive mites; frozen/stunned death prevents hatch and global cap holds.

rounds.feedback: Existing spitters do not offer a committed crossbow burst with a clear recovery window.
acceptance: Telegraph locked burst geometry, preserve dodge timing and interruption, and avoid instant hits.

rounds.feedback: Adding roles without bounded composition would produce clutter and unbounded ranged pressure.
acceptance: Weighted progression introduces roles in stages with role/ranged/global caps including adds.

rounds.feedback: Elite variety needs an actual mechanic rather than only larger stats or tinted sprites.
acceptance: A capped delayed death warning can be disarmed; pause/end/frozen death cannot produce late unfair damage.

rounds.feedback: The boss lacks a health-triggered change in attack rhythm and geometry.
acceptance: One-way55% transition uses three locked impact circles, readable recovery and bounded adds.

rounds.feedback: The four new enemy roles need distinct premium silhouettes without blocking startup or changing feet/picking mid-run.
acceptance: Load optional front/rear four-pose atlases outside critical readiness; pin each run, preserve planted feet, fallback and picking.

rounds.feedback: New AI phases require visual feedback that corresponds to real guard breaks, interruption and recovery.
acceptance: Bounded cues and telegraphs match actual state transitions and never mutate combat from drawing.

rounds.feedback: Players need actionable names, tells and counters for the expanded roster.
acceptance: Expose a usable keyboard/mobile guide covering the four roles, affix and boss phases with actual counterplay.

rounds.feedback: Lightning draw jitter consumes the same random stream as combat, so extra paints can change later crit/spawn/drop outcomes.
acceptance: Identical seeded inputs and simulation ticks yield identical HP/crit/drop/spawn decisions across extra draws, mute and reduced motion.

rounds.feedback: A CSS-hidden game iframe kept painting and simulating with W held:36 extra paints in350ms and document.hidden remainedfalse.
acceptance: Real parent messages and IO fallback stop hidden update/paint, clear input, preserve manual pause and resume without catch-up.

rounds.feedback: The renderer paints at host refresh even though costly actor drawing dominates dense mobile CPU.
acceptance: Offer bounded60/120Hz presentation independent of120Hz physics, with stable camera, aim, collision and truthful quality controls.

rounds.feedback: Eight ArrowDown presses rebuilt the whole graph eight times:5840 mutations and1472 removed top-level nodes.
acceptance: Selecting and navigating reuse graph nodes, preserve focus and update only changed selection/detail state.

rounds.feedback: The390px tree header consumes289px and tooltips use graph-wide rather than visible-viewport clamping.
acceptance: Compact controls leave usable graph height and tooltips stay visible at320/390px without covering the selected action.

rounds.feedback: Selecting a class rebuilds all cards and portrait canvases, losing the focused button.
acceptance: Reuse menu card and portrait nodes while preserving keyboard focus and selected class/follower semantics.

rounds.feedback: The locked-skill picker only toasts and a newly learned skill with four occupied slots has no direct equip path.
acceptance: Show actual prerequisites and route learning into an explicit slot choice without silently replacing a chosen skill or spending twice.

rounds.feedback: Active buff lifetimes, follower respawn and dangerous wrong-answer pressure have no persistent battle readout.
acceptance: Show bounded truthful status/timers for actual effects, follower state and wrong-answer streak without per-step DOM churn.

rounds.feedback: Mobile hints compete for combat space, cooldown labels obscure names, and casting a cooling skill silently returns.
acceptance: Keep skill states legible and controls usable; failed casts give throttled actionable feedback and hints can recede.

rounds.feedback: The end screen lacks elapsed time, accuracy percentage and equipped build; abandonment can use an inaccurate defeat cause.
acceptance: Report actual elapsed/accuracy/build/endcause and preserve replay/menu/reward flows.

rounds.feedback: Generated javelin art points northeast while the renderer assumes east before applying travel rotation.
acceptance: Explicit recipe source headings align real texture transforms with actual projectile travel.

rounds.feedback: Each Multishot/Strafe/axes/Stampede projectile redraws a full multi-object atlas motif, multiplying apparent bodies beyond physics.
acceptance: Keep generated cast bursts but render one physical body with one material wake per actual projectile.

rounds.feedback: A live flying projectile cycles anticipation/impact/fade frames and fades during its final220ms before removal.
acceptance: Hold active flight appearance until actual removal; preserve reduced-motion and source pinning.

rounds.feedback: Generic cast effects can draw a full target zone, shield or heal motif at the caster before that effect exists.
acceptance: Use compact class/skill cast sigils at the caster and reserve actual area motifs for their real sites.

rounds.feedback: A generic forked atlas at the origin can suggest branches beyond actual victim segments.
acceptance: Draw only copied actual chain segments with layered lightning and local contact sparks.

rounds.feedback: Small projectile collisions reuse complete weapon or cast motifs, including multi-arrow fans.
acceptance: Explicit contact/burst metadata selects compact local impacts versus true area explosion artwork.

rounds.feedback: Targeted Meteor/Hawk/Fist/Rain warning phases use basic placeholders before generated impact artwork.
acceptance: Use generated anticipation/release textures at the latched target with simulation-progress descent and no early impact frame.

rounds.feedback: Arrival effects can show an abstract additional burst rather than the movement actually completed.
acceptance: Use bounded wake/footprints from recorded start to actual endpoint without extending or changing swept collision.

rounds.feedback: Buff, shield and aura textures do not communicate their remaining simulation lifetime.
acceptance: Subtle nonstrobing remaining-duration runes follow actual lifetime, with functional reduced-motion expiry cues.

rounds.feedback: A visible long-lived Meteor/AoE can be evicted from the FIFO effect queue by24small projectile contacts while almost its full lifetime remains.
acceptance: Bound the queue while retaining important arrivals/AoE during contact floods; coalesce nearby same-skill contact sparks without suppressing distinct distant hits or changing damage.

notes: Only implemented and independently verified rounds count toward completedRounds.
Remaining rounds will be added from concrete evaluation feedback after earlier batches are rechecked; a list of assertions does not itself constitute fifty improvement rounds.
Wall-time benchmarks are advisory and controlled before/after comparisons; deterministic regressions check redundant work and behavior instead of machine-specific millisecond limits.

afterRound10.interpretation: Frozen-world and redundant UI work was removed. Dense actor rendering remains the largest cost. Host refresh cadence varied between captures, so no universal FPS percentage is inferred.
